{{Quote|Well, I guess the only thing left to do now is to take you to the thirteenth story of the administration building so the Fun World Document Droids can check over your papers.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Queen" />}}
'''Fun World Document Droids''' were a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used for examining legal documents on [[Hologram Fun World]].<ref name="Queen" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'' in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] traveled to Hologram Fun World to get [[Marriage/Legends|married]]. They met their friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] there, who asked for their [[birth certificate]]s to be taken to the Fun World Document Droids for inspection. However, neither Solo or Organa had their certificates available.<ref name="Queen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fun World Document Droids were mentioned in the [[1993]] junior novel ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Queen" />
